# Easynet IT Solutions Limited

> Easynet IT Solutions Limited is a 100% Papua New Guinea-owned IT consulting, sales and
> services company based in Port Moresby. It provides web design and website development,
> digital marketing, ERP and business automation, ICT infrastructure, networking, firewall
> and cybersecurity, server and cloud, backup, hardware supply and managed IT support to
> businesses across Papua New Guinea.

This file summarises the company and website for AI assistants, search engines and
automated agents. All facts below are also published as schema.org JSON-LD on the site.

## Company facts

- Legal name: Easynet IT Solutions Limited
- Ownership: 100% Papua New Guinea-owned
- Headquarters: 8 Mile, Gran Eden, Lot 110, Section 147, Port Moresby, National Capital District, Papua New Guinea
- Service area: Port Moresby and all of Papua New Guinea (on-site work via a local field project team; remote support and monitoring nationwide)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +675 72743186
- Email: hello.easynet@hotmail.com
- Business hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM (Port Moresby time)
- Website: https://easynetsolutions.com.pg/

## Services

Two delivery divisions cover eleven core services.

### Software & Digital Solutions
- Website Development — business websites designed and built in Port Moresby
- Digital Marketing & Leads — social media, advertising, lead management and tracking
- WhatsApp Automation — WhatsApp Business / WhatsApp API integration, auto-replies, lead capture
- ERP & Business Automation — ERPNext / Zoho implementation: accounting, sales, purchasing, inventory, CRM, POS, HR
- Custom Applications — bespoke software for specific operational needs

### ICT Infrastructure & Managed Services
- Network Solutions — LAN, Wi-Fi and office network design and installation
- Firewall & Cybersecurity — Fortinet, OPNsense, CrowdStrike; security hardening
- Server & Cloud — AWS, VMware, Synology, Microsoft 365
- Backup Solutions — business backup and off-site storage (Backblaze B2)
- Hardware Supply — computers, networking and office IT hardware
- IT Support — remote and on-site support; managed IT contracts

## Business packages

- Business Starter — business website, business email, social media setup, online presence launch
- Digital Growth — Starter plus advertising, lead management & tracking, WhatsApp automation
- Business Automation — Digital Growth plus CRM, sales, purchasing, inventory, accounting, workflow automation
- IT Office Setup — computers, network, Wi-Fi, firewall, CCTV, backup, Microsoft 365, business software suite
- Managed IT — monthly remote support, monitoring, maintenance, security and backup monitoring

Every service can also be purchased individually without a package.

## Industries served

Small and medium businesses, retail, professional services, construction, hotels,
schools, NGOs and corporate offices.

## Technology partners and platforms

ERPNext, Microsoft 365, Zoho, Cloudflare, Backblaze B2, Starlink, AWS, Fortinet,
OPNsense, Synology, Linux, VMware, Tailscale, CrowdStrike, React, Next.js, Vercel,
GitHub, Docker, PostgreSQL.

For advanced specialist work (ERPNext implementation, complex architecture, cloud or
cybersecurity design) Easynet engages 8N8 Systems as a consulting partner under a formal
agreement. Easynet remains the single accountable partner for the customer.

## Team

- Willie Batia — Director (business management, sales, customer relationships, finance, project coordination)
- Arka C — Chief Technology Officer (technical strategy, solution design, architecture, ERP/automation)
- Max Giamungi — IT Field Project Coordinator (on-site ICT projects, scheduling, customer liaison)

## How engagement works

1. Free initial discussion
2. Recommendation of a solution
3. Written proposal and quotation
4. Implementation
5. Ongoing support
